Browser errors never reach Sentry. **Fix:** Create both `instrumentation.ts` (server init) and `instrumentation-client.ts` (browser init) re-exporting the existing configs. 22 23 5. [Security] `app/api/auth/signup/route.ts:46` — `email_confirm: true` is set unconditionally on signup, bypassing email verification. Anyone can register any email and immediately access the platform. **Fix:** Set `email_confirm: false` and implement the verify-email flow. 24 25 6. [Security] `components/auth/LoginForm.tsx:54` — `redirectedFrom` param from query string is used as redirect target with no validation. Attacker can craft `/login?redirectedFrom=https://evil.com` → user lands on phishing site after login. **Fix:** Validate `redirectTo` starts with `/` and does not contain `//` or protocol. 26 27 7. [Security] `app/(auth)/callback/route.ts:12,65` — `next` query param used as redirect target with no validation (same open redirect issue, on the OAuth callback). **Fix:** Same validation as above. 28 29 8. [Security] `app/api/tax-forms/[id]/reveal-ssn/route.ts:72-82` — SSN decryption is **stubbed** and returns the literal string `'XXX-XX-XXXX (decryption requires DB pgcrypto setup)'`. UI believes a decrypt occurred. Feature is broken for its stated purpose. **Fix:** Implement pgcrypto-backed decrypt or disable the route. 30 31 9. [Bug] `app/api/payroll/tax-forms/[id]/reveal-ssn/route.ts:12` — delegates via `NextResponse.rewrite(url)` inside a route handler POST. Route handlers do not execute rewrites — the response is a rewrite directive that never invokes the target handler, so the endpoint is effectively broken. **Fix:** Inline the logic or `fetch()` the target route with headers forwarded. 32 33 10. [Bug] `app/api/schedule/apply-template/route.ts:73` — returns HTTP 501 with message `"Custom templates not yet available — run Sprint 8 DB migration"` even though the migration (`20260417230000_schedule_templates.sql`) exists and is applied. Users get a spurious "not available" error for working functionality. **Fix:** Query `schedule_templates` table and remove the 501 branch. 34 35 11. [Security] `app/api/webhooks/dodo/route.ts` — webhook registers events but the downstream `enqueueJob` calls for `send-email` (subscription renewal, payment failed, etc.) are no-op stubs. Customers never receive billing emails after Dodo events. **Fix:** Same as #1 (queue must be real). 36 37 12. [Bug] `app/(app)/consent-forms/templates/[id]/page.tsx:1-8` — the template detail page is a stub returning `

Detail view — future sprint

`. Clicking any template in the templates list lands users on a blank "future sprint" screen. **Fix:** Implement template detail/view route or remove the link from the list. 38 39 13. [Security] `app/api/billing/cancel/route.ts:50` + `app/api/billing/resume/route.ts:50` — both use `(dodo.subscriptions as unknown as {...}).update(...)` type-laundering. If Dodo's SDK signature changes, TypeScript won't catch it and customers could be silently mis-billed. **Fix:** Use the real SDK type or pin an interface. 40 41 14. [Security] `app/api/auth/signup/route.ts:11` — `password: z.string().min(8)` has no complexity requirements (no upper/lower/number check) and no max length. Allows trivial passwords (`12345678`) and unbounded-length DoS passwords. **Fix:** Add `.regex()` for complexity plus `.max(72)` (bcrypt's effective max). 42 43 15. [Security] `next.config.ts:27-42` — no Content-Security-Policy header configured. STS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy are present; CSP is missing. OWASP A05. **Fix:** Add a `Content-Security-Policy` header (start with `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-…'`). 44 45 16. [Bug] `.env.local` checked into repo working tree (not tracked via git — verified in `.gitignore`) contains service-role key and DB password. If anyone accidentally runs `git add -f .env.local` those secrets would ship to GitHub. Also secrets share the workspace — very brittle. **Fix:** Rotate + use Supabase Vault or Doppler / 1Password CLI. 46 47 17. [Bug] `components/ai/ShareDesignPage.tsx:121-123` — customer-facing "Book a consultation" CTA is wired to `window.alert()` with a TODO comment. Public-share pages (an acquisition surface) look broken. **Fix:** Link to `/book/[studioSlug]` and remove the TODO. 48 49 ## Major (fix in first post-launch sprint) 50 51 18. Combined with #3, public pages have zero rate limits. **Fix:** Put an IP-limited bucket in front of anonymous booking endpoints. 52 53 19. Creates false audit trail. **Fix:** Log after successful delete, or use a single SQL transaction. 56 57 21. The server manually remaps in the POST handler, but the GET query `.order('brand', …)` and the client form all use different field names. Import site determines which wins. **Fix:** Consolidate to one — prefer `useIsMobile.ts`, delete the other. 68 69 27. 10	export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
11	  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url)
12	  const code = searchParams.get('code')
13	  // Validate redirect target — prevent open-redirect (QA issue #7)

21	  // Handle OAuth errors from Supabase
22	  if (error ?? errorDescription) {
23	    const params = new URLSearchParams({ error: errorDescription ?? error ?? 'OAuth error' })
24	    return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/login?${params.toString()}`)
25	  }

22	const BUILTIN_TEMPLATES: Record<string, { day_of_week: number; start_time: string; end_time: string }[]> = {
23	  'mon-fri-9to5': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((d) => ({ day_of_week: d, start_time: '09:00:00', end_time: '17:00:00' })),
24	  'mon-sat-10to6': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((d) => ({ day_of_week: d, start_time: '10:00:00', end_time: '18:00:00' })),

28	export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
29	  const ip = getClientIp(req)
30	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
31	  if (!success) return Response.json({ error: 'Rate limited' }, { status: 429 })
32	
33	  const supabase = await createClient()
34	
35	  const {
36	    data: { user },
37	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
38	  if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
39	
40	  const { data: member } = await supabase
41	    .from('studio_members')
42	    .select('role, studio_id')
43	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
44	    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
45	    .limit(1)
46	    .single()
47	  if (!member) return Response.json({ error: 'No membership' }, { status: 403 })
48	
49	  if (member.role !== 'owner' && member.role !== 'admin') {
50	    return Response.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 })
51	  }
52	
53	  let body: unknown
54	  try {
55	    body = await req.json()
56	  } catch {
57	    return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }, { status: 400 })
58	  }
59	
60	  const parsed = ApplyTemplateSchema.safeParse(body)
61	  if (!parsed.success) {
62	    return Response.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 422 })
63	  }
64	
65	  const { template_id, target_week_start, artist_ids } = parsed.data
66	
67	  // Resolve template slots
68	  let templateSlots: { day_of_week: number; start_time: string; end_time: string }[]
69	
70	  if (BUILTIN_TEMPLATES[template_id]) {
71	    templateSlots = BUILTIN_TEMPLATES[template_id]!
72	  } else {
73	    // Look up custom template from schedule_templates table
74	    // Using raw select then casting because generated types may not include this table yet
75	    const { data: rawTemplate, error: templateError } = await supabase
76	      .from('schedule_templates')

82	    if (templateError || !rawTemplate) {

89	    }
90	
91	    // slots is stored as JSONB: [{day_of_week, start_time, end_time}]

121	    return Response.json({ data: { applied: newSlots.length } })
122	  } catch (err) {

125	  }
126	}
